passage:
Hi Hive Members,

As our community continues to grow, we've been looking for ways to ensure that "The Hive" remains a productive and professional environment for all our freelancers, startups, and remote workers. To maintain the balance between a collaborative atmosphere and a focused workspace, we are introducing a few updates to our membership terms, effective November 1.

The most significant update concerns our "Guest Policy." Previously, members could bring in guests for up to four hours without any additional charge. However, due to the limited seating in our common areas during the peak hours of 11:00 AM to 2:00 PM, we are introducing a "Guest Day Pass" for $15. If you are meeting a client for a quick coffee (under 30 minutes), there is still no charge. However, if they plan to stay and work alongside you for the afternoon, they will need to register at the front desk and wear a "Visitor" lanyard.

We're also excited to announce that we are upgrading our "Private Meeting Room" booking system. Starting next week, you will be able to book rooms directly through our new mobile app. To ensure fair access, each member will now have a "Monthly Credit" of 10 hours for small meeting rooms. If you exceed this limit, additional hours can be purchased at a discounted member rate of $10 per hour.

Regarding our facilities, we've heard your requests for more ergonomic options! We have ordered 15 new "Apex-Pro" standing desks, which will be installed in the "Focus Zone" on the second floor this Friday. During the installation, that section of the building will be closed from 8:00 AM to noon. Please plan to use the "Social Lounge" on the first floor if you arrive early.

Finally, we've decided to extend our Friday "Happy Hour." Starting next month, we'll provide local craft beer and snacks starting at 4:00 PM to help everyone network and celebrate the end of the work week.

Thanks for being such a vital part of our community!

Best,
The Hive Management Team
